digest.component_or_area: store git call sites (event_append, compact, delete, txn, fsck, metrics)
propositions: Local git operations under high concurrent agent load contend on shared .git lock files (index.lock, HEAD.lock, packed-refs.lock) and surface errors to callers instead of absorbing them.

Transient lock conflicts must resolve silently with bounded jittered retry/backoff (~tens of seconds); only permanently stuck locks (budget exhausted) surface one actionable error naming the lock file and holder guidance.
Per-store advisory lock (fcntl) plus jittered backoff on git-level lock signatures (index/ref/config) serializes rebar writers and auto-releases on process death without staleness logic.
Every local-only git call site must be explicitly bounded with a watchdog (120s–300s depending on operation type) justified against local latency, not copied from network timeouts.
Store write-lock contention sleeps (50ms/100ms) must be jittered uniformly [0.75, 1.25] to prevent thundering herd; uncontended ops must add zero latency (no happy-path sleep).
